pr_title: Disable multi-window buttons instead of hiding them when support is unavailable
pr_body:
This is more explicit as for why this functionality isn't available depending on editor settings and current platform.

This also exposes a `EditorInterface.is_multi_window_enabled()` method so that editor plugins can easily query whether the editor is able and expected to create multiple windows.

- This closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/84435.

## Preview

![Screenshot_20231106_123931](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/180032/c8472080-b112-492b-a435-6ed49b83e4c6)

![Screenshot_20231106_124049](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/180032/90b0f643-eb2a-470f-9e98-07e0098990c0)
pr_comments:
Rebased and tested again, it works as expected.

I've tried to read `OS.get_cmdline_args()` to check whether `--single-window` was used, but it's not present in the list of arguments when you pass it to the editor.

> I've tried to read OS.get_cmdline_args() to check whether --single-window was used, but it's not present in the list of arguments when you pass it to the editor.

Instead you should check if `FEATURE_SUBWINDOWS` is supported by DisplayServer. Right now when you use `--single-window`, the button will say that multiwindow is not supported by the current platform.

issue_context.title: Floating script editor button is hidden when Single Window Mode is enabled
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.2 beta4

### System information

Godot v4.2.beta4 - Windows 10.0.19045 - GLES3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.2647) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-7700HQ CPU @ 2.80GHz (8 Threads)

### Issue description

The button to make the script editor floating is no longer present in 4.2 beta 4

4.2:
![image](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/32916571/58f8eaca-14d7-4585-8fcd-c2fdb155059b)

4.1:
![image](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/32916571/6b3df109-28d4-4f16-838a-f5cf642dfb28)


Also using the ctrl shift P shorting and selecting "make floating" under the script editor section does nothing

### Steps to reproduce

Open a script, notice there is no floating button. 

Try to use "make floating" option using ctrl shift P, notice it does nothing

### Minimal reproduction project

N/A
comments:
I can see it here in 4.2.beta da0b1eb12 (Linux):

![image](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/180032/b00b9031-5ec9-498b-b45b-7135064907ff)

Make sure **Single Window Mode** is unchecked in the Editor Settings, or this option will be unavailable. Perhaps we should disable the icon with a tooltip instead of hiding it entirely.
You are correct, disabling single window mode reveals the floating button, and it works
sorry, reopened as I see you changed the title to reflect the button being hidden

review_comments: Seems like this tooltip is lost and now it refers to script/shader editor as "this panel". Since the disabled logic runs in the constructor, you could check if the button is not disabled and ovewrite the tooltip.
